target: Violate HACKDAC_p5: it must never happen that debug_mode_q is asserted while umode_i is also asserted (user mode in debug). Find a state where debug_mode_q==1 AND umode_i==1.

milestones.description: Reset deasserted, processor starts in machine mode, debug_mode_q is 0
Debug request arrives, processor transitions toward debug mode
Violation: debug_mode_q asserted while umode_i is also asserted (user mode active in debug — incorrect access control)
